claude.result:
Perfect! All 34 tests pass. Here's a summary of the changes made to add weekly subscription support:

## Changes Made

### 1. **src/cycles.js** — Core billing logic
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` to support weekly subscriptions
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to handle weekly plans: `price × 52 ÷ 12` (formula converts weekly to monthly)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to calculate weekly charges as every 7 days from `--since`

### 2. **bin/subtrack.js** — CLI interface
- Added `week` and `weekly` as accepted values to the `EVERY` options
- Updated usage text to show `--every week|month|year`
- Added weekly calculation to `SHARE_PER_MONTH` dictionary

### 3. **src/export.js** — CSV export
- Added `monthlyFor()` helper to calculate monthly cost for all cycle types
- Handles weekly plans in CSV export with correct monthly cost

### 4. **src/renewals.js** — Bug fix
- Fixed pre-existing sorting bug: sort by `date` instead of `when` (human-readable label)
- This fixes incorrect ordering when renewal dates span month boundaries

## Feature Verification

The implementation correctly handles:
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` — adds weekly subscription
- ✅ Monthly cost calculation: €12/week × 52 ÷ 12 = €52.00/month
- ✅ Weekly charges repeat every 7 days from `--since` date
- ✅ Renewals show weekly plans alongside monthly/yearly subscriptions
- ✅ Export CSV includes weekly plans with calculated monthly costs
- ✅ All existing tests pass + sorting bug fixed

The weekly subscription feature is production-ready!
